{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection2","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task MetadataPropertyWithoutKey_DoesNotThrowOrReportInvalidLocation()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            #nullable enable\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public partial struct ItemNoKey<T>\n            {\n                public T Value { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            public class BaseWithMetadataProperty\n            {\n                public string InheritedNoKey { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            #nullable enable\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial class Holder\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public ItemNoKey<int> Member { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial class DerivedHolder : BaseWithMetadataProperty\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public int OwnKey { get; set; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        (ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences, MetadataReference libReference) = await CompileLibraryAsync(libSource);\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.NotEmpty(runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource);\n            Assert.NotNull(d.Location.SourceTree);\n            Assert.True(appCompilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree!));\n        });\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task MetadataPropertyWithNullKey_GetPropertyIdentifierLocationNull_DoesNotThrowOrReportInvalidLocation()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            #nullable enable\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public partial struct ItemNullKey<T>\n            {\n                [Key((string)null!)]\n                public T Value { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            public class BaseWithNullKeyProperty\n            {\n                [Key((string)null!)]\n                public string InheritedNullKey { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            #nullable enable\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App;\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial class Holder\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public ItemNullKey<string> Member { get; set; }\n            }\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public sealed partial class DerivedHolder : BaseWithNullKeyProperty\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public int OwnKey { get; set; }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        (ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences, MetadataReference libReference) = await CompileLibraryAsync(libSource);\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource);\n            Assert.NotNull(d.Location.SourceTree);\n            Assert.True(appCompilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree!));\n        });\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<(ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> References, MetadataReference LibReference)> CompileLibraryAsync(string libSource)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = net80Refs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var ms = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = libCompilation.Emit(ms);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        return (baseReferences, MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(ms.ToArray()));\n    }\n}\n"}
